text:
You need a full-function e-commerce Shopify store for fashion, clothing, electronics, and other products, with strong templates, clear menus, payment pages, conversion-focused flows, and notification alerts.

Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne. I’m a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience building modern web products with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. I can help you create a Shopify store that feels polished, trustworthy, and built to convert.

I’ve built checkout-heavy products where user flow, speed, and reliability mattered. One example was a booking platform for fitness studios built with Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma, and Stripe. It was a white-label app with separate subdomains, timetables, and memberships for each studio, and it reached 64 studios onboarded in 6 months with a 71% checkout conversion rate. That experience is directly relevant to setting up a smooth purchasing journey, clear payment flow, and conversion-friendly storefront structure.

I also built a monthly statement PDF generator for Alder Property Group using Node.js, BullMQ, Redis, Puppeteer, and AWS S3. That system rendered owner statements to PDF overnight instead of generating them on request, processing 12k statements a month and removing daily request timeouts. I mention this because it reflects the kind of backend reliability and automation that helps keep an e-commerce store responsive, especially when notifications, order handling, and customer-facing operations need to run smoothly.

For your Shopify store, I would focus on:
- a clean storefront design with strong visual hierarchy
- product/category navigation for multiple product types
- optimized product and checkout pages
- payment setup and conversion-oriented user flows
- notification and alert behavior for key store events
- mobile-friendly layouts and a polished shopping experience

I’m comfortable working across both front-end and back-end pieces, and I pay close attention to usability, performance, and conversion. If you want a store that looks professional and is built to support sales from day one, I’d be glad to help.
